response.query: Which facilitator competency metrics, certification criteria, supervision cadence, and fidelity checklist items (with rater training and interrater reliability targets) will operationalize training?
response.answer: Facilitator competency metrics include fidelity checklist items, supervision cadence, and interrater reliability targets with rater training. Certification criteria and fidelity checklist items focus on maintaining high standards and consistency. Interrater reliability targets aim for at least 85% agreement.
